label: Crisp
description: Answer website chats: wake on visitor messages, reply, add notes, resolve and assign conversations

operations.name: send_message
operations.description: Reply to the visitor in a Crisp conversation, as the team.

operations.name: send_file
operations.description: Send the visitor a file in a Crisp conversation, from a public URL.

operations.name: add_note
operations.description: Add a private note to a Crisp conversation: the team sees it in the inbox, the visitor never does.

operations.name: get_messages
operations.description: Read a Crisp conversation's messages, the latest batch first; from "user" is the visitor, "operator" the team (and NoClick).

operations.name: list_conversations
operations.description: List or search the workspace's Crisp conversations, most recently active first.

operations.name: get_conversation
operations.description: Get a Crisp conversation: its state, assignee, unread counts, last message and the visitor's details.

operations.name: set_conversation_state
operations.description: Resolve a Crisp conversation, or reopen it as unresolved or pending.

operations.name: assign_conversation
operations.description: Assign a Crisp conversation to a teammate (an operator), e.g. to hand it to a human.

operations.name: list_operators
operations.description: List the workspace's teammates (operators) with their user_id, name, role and availability.

operations.name: get_visitor
operations.description: Get who is writing in a Crisp conversation: name, email, phone, segments, custom data, location and device.

operations.name: update_visitor
operations.description: Update a Crisp conversation's visitor details or subject; only the fields given change.

operations.name: get_contact
operations.description: Get a contact's Crisp profile (name, company, segments, notes) by email or people_id.

operations.name: get_website
operations.description: Get the connected Crisp workspace: its name and domain.

operations.name: on_visitor_message
operations.description: Wake when a visitor sends a message in a Crisp conversation. The team's replies and notes, and messages NoClick sent, never fire it.

summary: Crisp live chat: reply to visitors, add notes, resolve and assign conversations, and wake on visitor messages.
